title: Liberman's goldfish centrifuge-and-freezing experiment

tellings.quote: a lot of this is centered around an experiment he did with goldfish he took four goldfish

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a Soviet scientist, Efim Liberman, who he says did an experiment with four goldfish, spinning them in a centrifuge, a fast-spinning machine, and freezing them. Michels brings it up while talking about the idea that the brain may work in quantum ways, even in ways linked to time, with much of Liberman's thinking centered on that experiment.
